name: qfd_hub_fr-32c8ac189-mm
purpose: Gate link_credit_rtt: full-rate Qwen hub successor (CR=128 link credits covering the measured 117/119-cycle credit RTT; per-link 8-word output FIFOs; 8-word x3 skid; native credit range faults), frame 561.6 um square; same r21 pins/kit as qfd_hub [flow-hold: rule H1 kit + multi-mode route hold repair]

bench.name: linkfr_neg_credit_overflow
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -s tb_qwen_link_fullrate -Ptb_qwen_link_fullrate.NEG=2 -Ptb_qwen_link_fullrate.N=512 -o {RUN}/bench/n2 rtl/test/tb_qwen_link_fullrate.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_hub_fr.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_cdc_ch.sv rtl/lib/ot_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_link_fwd_full_tmr.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/n2 | tee {RUN}/bench/n2.log; grep -q '^PASS' {RUN}/bench/n2.log

calibrate.reason: die-context IO is referenced IN-RUN to this block's own propagated clock (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the predecessor qfd_hub-load80 job; no Qwen budget sheet

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/hbm_fmax_attn_abstract.py --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --name qfd_hub_fr --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_hub_fr --image openroad/orfs:asap7lock > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: no Qwen r21 budget sheet; masters kit budgets applied in-run (as qfd_hub)

cycles_added: 0 cycles on the AR token: same 54/55 registered link stations (credit RTT 117/119 unchanged); the link now streams 1 word/cycle instead of <= 4/118 (credit-starved); hub endpoint latency unchanged except per-link output FIFO (+0: write and read in the cycles the predecessor's held register used). Area: frame 412.536^2 -> 561.6^2.
